all_sites_results <- list()

for (s in sites) {

  cat("Processing", s, "\n")

  ## ---- subset obs

  obs_site <- data[site == s]
  
  #obs_site2=obs_site[!duplicated(obs_site)]
  
  obs_site2 <- obs_site[rel_year >= 0]


  obs_site_wide <- dcast(
  obs_site2,
  treatment+site + subplot + plot+ year ~ variable,
  value.var = "value"
)


  ## ---- climate stack
  clim_all <- rbindlist(
    lapply(clim_by_site[[s]], function(x) x$climate[[1]]),
    idcol = "plot"
  )
  
  
  clim_all[, tmean := (tmax + tmin) / 2]
  
  clim_all[, cwd := NA_real_]#pre-allocated      
  
  clim_all[
  , wmy := month[which.max(ppt)],
  by = year]#wettest month per year
  

#function compute CWD

fcwd_et <- function(cwd, ppt, aet, wmy, month, min_aet = 40, throughfall = 1,
                    reset_wmy = TRUE, min_cwd = -1000) {
  # ppt: monthly precipitation
  # eat: evapotranspiration (actual or climatological)
  # wmy: wettest month of the year
  # min_et: minimum ET threshold to avoid unrealistically low ET
  # throughfall: fraction of ppt that contributes to water balance
  # reset_wmy: logical, reset CWD at wettest month
  # min_cwd: lower bound for cumulative deficit

  n <- length(ppt)           # number of months in the series
  cwd[1] <- 0                # initial CWD: first month starts at zero

  for (i in 2:n) {           # loop from month 2 to end
    # accumulate CWD: previous month's deficit + current month's water balance
    cwd[i] <- cwd[i - 1] + (throughfall * ppt[i]) - max(aet[i], min_aet, na.rm = TRUE)

    # reset CWD to zero if this is the wettest month
    if (reset_wmy) {
      if (i <= length(wmy) && month[i] == wmy[i]) cwd[i] <- 0
    }

    # impose lower bound: deficit cannot exceed min_cwd
    cwd[i] <- max(cwd[i], min_cwd)
  }

  return(cwd)                # return the full CWD vector
}
  setorder(clim_all, plot, year, month)
  
  clim_all[, cwd := fcwd_et(cwd, ppt, aet, wmy, month)]

  #get mean and sigma of all months for this period
  
  clim_stats <- clim_all[year >= 1981 & year <= 2010][, .(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax),
    sd_tmax   = sd(tmax),
    mean_vpd  = mean(vpd),
    sd_vpd    = sd(vpd),
    mean_srad = mean(srad),
    sd_srad   = sd(srad),
    mean_cwd = mean(cwd, na.rm=TRUE),
    sd_cwd   = sd(cwd, na.rm=TRUE),
    mean_tmean = mean(tmean, na.rm=TRUE),
    sd_tmean   = sd(tmean, na.rm=TRUE)
  ), by = c("plot", "month")]

  clim_all <- merge(clim_all, clim_stats, by = c("plot", "month"), all.x = TRUE)

  ## ---- standardize: standardized anomalies (z-scores) to account for the natural variability of each plot.
  clim_all[, `:=`(
    z_tmax = (tmax - mean_tmax) / sd_tmax,
    z_vpd  = (vpd  - mean_vpd)  / sd_vpd,
    z_srad = (srad - mean_srad) / sd_srad,
    z_cwd  = (cwd  - mean_cwd)  / sd_cwd,
    z_tmean = (tmean - mean_tmean) / sd_tmean
  )]
  
  #Set intervals to match inventories years with mean(or max) climate anomaly
  
obs_site_wide <- obs_site_wide[order(subplot, year)]

obs_site_wide[, interval := .GRP, by = .(subplot, year)] #groups the data by subplot × year. it gives the group number in the order groups appear
obs_site_wide[, year_end := shift(year, type = "lead"), by = subplot] #for each subplot, year_end is the next census year
obs_site_wide[is.na(year_end), year_end := max(year), by=subplot] #The last year per subplot has no “next” year = NA. NA is replaced by max year
obs_site_wide[, interval := paste0(year, "_", year_end)]


intervals <- obs_site_wide[, .(subplot, plot, interval, year_start = year, year_end)]

# start and end year on climate data
clim_all[, `:=`(year_start = year, year_end = year)]

# 2️⃣ Set keys for foverlaps
setkey(intervals, plot, year_start, year_end)
setkey(clim_all, plot, year_start, year_end)

# 3️⃣ Perform the non-equi join
clim_all_interval <- foverlaps(
  clim_all,       # x #For each climate year, find the inventory interval it belongs to
  intervals,      # y
  by.x = c("plot", "year_start", "year_end"),
  by.y = c("plot", "year_start", "year_end"),
  type = "within",  # keep climate years inside interval
nomatch = 0L      # drop climate years outside any interval
  )


  ## ---- aggregate per census
census_anom <- clim_all_interval[, .(
  mean_z_tmax  = mean(z_tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_z_tmax   = max(z_tmax,  na.rm = TRUE),
  
  mean_z_vpd   = mean(z_vpd,  na.rm = TRUE),
  max_z_vpd    = max(z_vpd,   na.rm = TRUE),
  
  mean_z_srad  = mean(z_srad, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_z_srad   = max(z_srad,  na.rm = TRUE),
  
  mean_z_cwd   = mean(z_cwd,  na.rm = TRUE),
  max_z_cwd    = max(z_cwd,   na.rm = TRUE),
  
  mean_z_tmean = mean(z_tmean, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_z_tmean  = max(z_tmean,  na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(plot, interval)]#For each plot and census year, average all monthly anomalies that were labeled with that census year. ex: year_bin = 1985, all months from all years from 1982–1985 are averaged (if let's say the last inventory year - year_bin was 1981)

  ## ---- merge obs + climate
  merged_site <- merge(
  obs_site_wide, 
    census_anom,
    by = c("plot", "interval"),
    all.x = TRUE
  )

  ## ---- store
  census_anom_all_sites[[s]] <- census_anom

  all_sites_results[[s]] <- merged_site
}

Generate model residuals with BAM

#agb growth

Code 
merged=merged[, plot := as.factor(plot)]
merged=merged[, subplot := as.factor(subplot)]
merged=merged[, treatment := as.factor(treatment)]
merged[, interval_num := as.numeric(sub("_.*", "", interval))]


site_models <- list()


for (s in sites) {
  merged_site <- merged[site == s]
  site_models[[s]] <- list()
  
  AR <- ave(merged_site$interval_num, merged_site$subplot, FUN = function(x) x == min(x)) |> as.logical()#TRUE for the first census year per subplot

    # choose k based on unique years
  
  ny <- uniqueN(merged_site$interval_num)

  k_use <- fifelse(ny <= 20, 3,
          fifelse(ny <= 25, 5, 7))
  
  cat("Site:", s, "- unique years:", uniqueN(merged_site$interval_num), "- k used:", k_use, "\n")
  
    # ---- 1) baseline model (NO AR) - used to estimate rho
  m0 <- bam(
    agb_growth ~
      s(interval_num, k = k_use) +
      s(treatment, bs = "re") +
      s(subplot, bs = "re") +
      s(interval_num, subplot, bs = "fs", k = k_use),#continuous and categorical variable
    data = merged_site,
    discrete = FALSE
  )
  

mf0 <- model.frame(m0)

res0 <- resid(m0, type = "response")

# Compute lag-1 autocorrelation for each subplot separately

acf_list <- lapply(split(res0, mf0$subplot), function(x) {
  if(length(x) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  acf(x, plot = FALSE)$acf[2]
})

# Pick the largest absolute lag-1 among all subplots for the site
# This ensures that rho0 captures the strongest temporal correlation present
rho0 <- max(abs(unlist(acf_list)), na.rm = TRUE)
rho0 <- max(min(rho0, 0.8), 0)

  cat("  estimated rho:", round(rho0, 3), "\n")
  

  # fit BAM
    mod <- bam(
      agb_growth ~ s(interval_num, k = k_use)+ 
        s(treatment, bs="re") +
                   s(subplot, bs="re") +
                   s(interval_num, subplot, bs="fs", k=k_use),
      data = merged_site,
      rho = rho0, 
      AR.start = AR,
      discrete = F#T is for very large datasets, some accuracy is traded for speed
    )
  
  res <- residuals(mod, type="response")
  
mf <- model.frame(mod)

acf_res <- tapply(
  res,
  mf$subplot,
  function(x) {
    if (length(x) < 3) return(NULL)
    acf(x, plot = FALSE)
  }
)  
      site_models[[s]]<- list(
      model = mod,
      rho = rho0,
      residuals = res,
      acf = acf_res
    )
      
#print(acf_res)[[s]]#Mbaiki: residuals 10 years apart are still correlated at ~0.59.lag-1 = consecutive censuses, lag-2 = two censuses apart

}

full BAM models - for all climatic variables

Code 
# ---------------------------
# climate variables to test
# ---------------------------
clim_vars <- c(
  "mean_z_tmax",
  "mean_z_vpd",
  "mean_z_srad",
  "mean_z_cwd"
)

site_models2 <- list()
table_results_combined <- list()

# ===========================
# LOOP OVER SITES
# ===========================
for (s in sites) {

  merged_site <- merged[site == s]

  # choose k based on number of intervals
  ny <- uniqueN(merged_site$interval_num)
  k_use <- fifelse(ny <= 20, 3,
            fifelse(ny <= 25, 5, 7))

  # cat("Site:", s,
  #     "- unique intervals:", ny,
  #     "- k used:", k_use, "\n")

  # ===========================
  # LOOP OVER CLIMATE VARIABLES
  # ===========================
  for (cv in clim_vars) {

    #cat("   Climate variable:", cv, "\n")

    clim_term <- paste0(cv, ":treatment")

   
    # ---------------------------
    # AR structure
    # ---------------------------
    AR <- ave(
      merged_site$interval_num,
      merged_site$subplot,
      FUN = function(x) x == min(x)
    ) |> as.logical()

    # ---------------------------
    # Baseline BAM (estimate rho)
    # ---------------------------
    f_bam0 <- as.formula(paste(
      "agb_growth ~",
      "s(interval_num, k=", k_use, ") +",
      "s(treatment, bs='re') +",
      "s(subplot, bs='re') +",
      "s(interval_num, subplot, bs='fs', k=", k_use, ") +",
      clim_term
    ))

    m0 <- bam(
      f_bam0,
      data = merged_site,
      discrete = FALSE
    )

    mf0  <- model.frame(m0)
    res0 <- resid(m0, type = "response")

    acf_list <- lapply(
      split(res0, mf0$subplot),
      function(x) {
        if (length(x) < 3) return(NA_real_)
        acf(x, plot = FALSE)$acf[2]
      }
    )

    rho0 <- max(abs(unlist(acf_list)), na.rm = TRUE)
    rho0 <- max(min(rho0, 0.8), 0)

    #cat("     estimated rho:", round(rho0, 3), "\n")

    # ---------------------------
    # BAM with AR(1)
    # ---------------------------
    mod3 <- bam(
      f_bam0,
      data = merged_site,
      rho = rho0,
      AR.start = AR,
      discrete = FALSE
    )

    tab_mod3 <- bind_rows(
      broom::tidy(mod3, parametric = TRUE)  %>% mutate(Term_type = "parametric"),
      broom::tidy(mod3, parametric = FALSE) %>% mutate(Term_type = "smooth")
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        Model_type = "BAM_re",
        Model      = s,
        Climate    = cv
      )

    # store diagnostics once per site
    if (cv == clim_vars[1]) {

      res <- residuals(mod, type = "response")
      mf  <- model.frame(mod)

      acf_res <- tapply(
        res,
        mf$subplot,
        function(x) {
          if (length(x) < 3) return(NULL)
          acf(x, plot = FALSE)
        }
      )

      site_models2[[s]] <- list(
        model      = mod,
        rho        = rho0,
        residuals = res,
        acf        = acf_res
      )
    }

    # ---------------------------
    # COMBINE MODELS
    # ---------------------------
    table_results_combined[[paste(s, cv, sep = "_")]] <-tab_mod3
     
  }
}

# ===========================
# FINAL TABLE
# ===========================
final_table_combined <- bind_rows(table_results_combined) %>%
  filter(grepl("treatment", term))


res_plot2 <- rbindlist(
  lapply(names(site_models2), function(s) {
    df_site <- merged[site == s]
    
    # only rows used in BAM
    used <- !is.na(df_site$agb_growth)
    
    data.table(
      site = s,
      interval_num = df_site$interval_num[used],
      subplot = df_site$subplot[used],
      residual = site_models2[[s]]$residuals
    )
  })
)

final_plot_df <- final_table_combined %>%
  filter(
    Term_type == "parametric",
    grepl(":treatment", term)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # extract treatment name generically
    Treatment = sub(".*:treatment", "", term)
  )

# ----------------------------------
# Loop over climate variables

for (cv in unique(final_plot_df$Climate)) {

  cat("Plotting climate variable:", cv, "\n")

  df_cv <- final_plot_df %>%
    filter(Climate == cv)

    pd <- position_dodge(width = 1.0)

    p <- ggplot(
      df_cv,
      aes(
        x = estimate,
        y = Model_type,
        color = Treatment
      )
    ) +
      geom_point(size = 2, position = pd) +
      geom_errorbarh(
        aes(
          xmin = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
          xmax = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
        ),
        height = 0.25, 
          position = pd
      ) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      facet_wrap(~ Model, ncol = 1) +
      labs(
        x = "Treatment effect (±95% CI)",
        y = "Model type",
        title = paste(
          "Treatment effects (control vs logged)",
          "\nClimate:", cv
        )
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    

    print(p)
  }

See the effect of climate anomalies on the residuals of BAM models - exclude first and last data

Code 
re_merged=merge(merged, res_plot, by=c( "site" , "interval_num" ,"subplot"))

clim_vars <- c(
  "mean_z_tmax",
  "mean_z_vpd",
  "mean_z_srad",
  "mean_z_cwd"
)


table_results_combined2 <- list()

for (s in sites) {
  merged_site <- re_merged[site == s]

  # Remove first and last year for this site
  merged_site <- merged_site[, {
    yr_sort <- sort(unique(interval_num))      # sort the years
    .SD[!(interval_num %in% c(min(yr_sort), max(yr_sort)))]  # remove first and last res
  }, by = plot]
  
  for (cv in clim_vars) {

    #cat("   Climate variable:", cv, "\n")

    clim_term <- paste0(cv, ":treatment")
    fmla <- as.formula(paste("residual ~", clim_term, "+ (1 | subplot)"))
    
 # fit lm
  mod4 <- lme4::lmer(
    fmla,
    data = merged_site,
    REML =TRUE,
    na.action = na.omit
  )
      
tab_mod4 <- broom.mixed::tidy(
  mod4,
  effects = "fixed"
) %>%
  mutate(
    Term_type  = "parametric",
    Model_type = "LMMres_BAM",
    Model      = s,
    Climate    = cv
  )  


  
  # ---- combine both models for this site ----
table_results_combined2[[paste(s, cv, sep = "_")]] <- tab_mod4
  }
}

# combine all sites into one table
final_table_combined2 <- bind_rows(table_results_combined2) 

final_table_combined2 <- final_table_combined2 %>%
  filter(grepl("treatment", term))

Code 
plot_df <- final_table_combined2 %>%
  filter(
    Term_type == "parametric",
    grepl("treatment", term)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = sub(".*:treatment", "", term)
  )

z95 <- 1.96
z50 <- qnorm(0.75)  # 50% CI

combined_df <- bind_rows(plot_df, final_plot_df)

for (cv in unique(combined_df$Climate)) {

  cat("Plotting climate variable:", cv, "\n")

  df_cv <- combined_df %>%
    filter(Climate == cv)
  
  df_cv <- df_cv %>%
  mutate(
    Model_type = factor(Model_type, levels = c("LMMres_BAM", "BAM_re")),
    y_model = as.numeric(Model_type) * 2   # <--- controls spacing between model types
  )

    pd <- position_dodge(width = 1.2)
  p <- ggplot(
    df_cv,
    aes(
      x = estimate,
      y = interaction(Model_type, Model),
      color=Treatment, 
      group=Treatment
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, position = pd) +
    geom_errorbarh(
      aes(
        xmin = estimate - z95 * std.error,
        xmax = estimate + z95 * std.error
      ),
      position = pd,
      height = 0.25,
      linewidth = 0.4,
      alpha = 0.4
    ) +

    ## 50% CI (foreground)
    geom_errorbarh(
      aes(
        xmin = estimate - z50 * std.error,
        xmax = estimate + z50 * std.error
      ),
      position = pd,
      height = 0.15,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      facet_wrap(~ Model, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(
        x = "Treatment effect (±95 and 50% CI)",
        y = "Model type",
        title = paste(
          "Treatment effects (control vs logged)",
          "\nClimate:", cv
        ))+
         theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_blank(),   # ← removes "Corinto", "Jari", etc
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

  print(p)

}

  )
